lines.line: * Given a notebook is open with every heading folded
* When the user chooses View > Unfold All
* Then the view shows the whole text of the file

problems.problem: This requires every paragraph to appear in one viewport sample. A smaller window could correctly unfold the file while requiring scrolling, causing this expectation to fail. This is advisory because it depends on another window size; no coverage gap is established for this short fixture in the check's own situation.

summary: No blocking problems. The check establishes folded headings, invokes Unfold All, and checks the complete fixture text, offsets, fold state, and paragraph spacing.
